notes.title: Check out OrbiTowers new Alpha-Trailer
notes.notes: [p]Much has happened since we started working on OrbiTower and even just in the last few months there has been a lot of exciting progress.[/p][p]Check out our new trailer to catch a glimpse of some [b]new mechanics[/b], [b]towers[/b] and [b]locations[/b]. You might also see gameplay hints of our [i]amphibious[/i] friend [b]Dr. Gillian [/b] (OrbiTower's second playable character). She's already been very popular with demo players at GGBavaria and we hope you'll love her in the final release too.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="N4jZx_1tP-g;full"][/previewyoutube]
